title: github.token shorthand check only matches string values
answers: policy crashes on non-string with value
github.token shorthand false positive on boolean or object input
why does contains_github_token need a type guard
body:
Symptom: the github.token shorthand policy fails or misfires when a with: or env: value is not a string (e.g. a boolean or mapping).
Root cause: .github/policy.rego:contains_github_token ran regex.match directly on arbitrary YAML values.
Fix pattern: guard with `is_string(value)` before the regex.match on `${{ github.token }}`.
Constraints: any new helper that regex-matches YAML values should guard with is_string first; the same check is used for both with: and env: via deny_github_token_shorthand.
applies: Helpers in .github/policy.rego that regex-match arbitrary workflow or action input values.
says: Workflow policy check crashes when action inputs use boolean flags or object values.
Security policy validation fails unexpectedly on non-string environment variables in pipeline files.
Prevent false token alert errors when workflow step settings contain structured YAML blocks.
Fix policy linter crash caused by evaluating non-text values in automation definitions.
search: Workflow policy checks in .github/policy.rego matching ${{ github.token }} must guard with is_string(value) before regex.match. This prevents errors and false positives when arbitrary with: or env: values are booleans or mappings. Applies to contains_github_token and any new helper in .github/policy.rego that regex-matches arbitrary YAML values, used by deny_github_token_shorthand.
